title: Personal and family
description: Family members and relationships, pets, homes and places, trips, appointments, belongings, subscriptions and documents of daily life. Never store passwords, card numbers or other secrets here.

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: An individual: family member, friend, doctor, neighbour. Use for: people by name or relation. Not for: companies (Organization). Examples: 'Lucía (daughter)', 'Dr. Pérez'.

entity_types.name: Household
entity_types.description: A home and the people who live together in it. Use for: a family unit or a residence as a group. Not for: the building as a place (Place). Examples: 'our flat in Madrid', 'the García family'.

entity_types.name: Pet
entity_types.description: An animal that belongs to the household. Not for: wild animals or animals of other people's households unless they matter. Examples: 'Luna the cat', 'Rex the dog'.

entity_types.name: Place
entity_types.description: A named place or address: home, school, shop, city, venue. Not for: websites. Examples: 'Parque del Retiro', 'Grandma's house'.

entity_types.name: Event
entity_types.description: A dated occurrence: birthday, celebration, school event, outage at home. Not for: scheduled health or admin visits (Appointment) or journeys (Trip). Examples: 'Lucía's birthday 2026-05-04'.

entity_types.name: Trip
entity_types.description: A journey or holiday with a destination and dates. Not for: a single outing with no travel, or a place itself (Place). Examples: 'Summer in Asturias 2026', 'Weekend in Lisbon'.

entity_types.name: Appointment
entity_types.description: A scheduled visit or meeting with a professional or service: medical, school, administrative, repair. Not for: family or social occasions (Event). Examples: 'Dentist 2026-11-03', 'ITV inspection'.

entity_types.name: Item
entity_types.description: A belonging or product worth remembering: appliance, vehicle, device, furniture, with its model or warranty. Not for: recurring contracts (Subscription) or documents about it (Document). Examples: 'Samsung washing machine', 'Seat Ibiza 2019'.

entity_types.name: Subscription
entity_types.description: A recurring service or contract: streaming, insurance, utilities, memberships. Record provider and renewal date, never credentials. Not for: one-off purchases (Item). Examples: 'Netflix', 'Home insurance'.

entity_types.name: Document
entity_types.description: A paper or digital document that can be cited: contract, invoice, warranty, recipe, certificate. Not for: the thing it is about (Item, Subscription). Examples: 'Rental contract', 'Car insurance policy'.

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: A company or institution: school, bank, employer, shop, clinic. Not for: a person, or a place where it is located (Place). Examples: 'CEIP San José', 'Banco X'.

entity_types.name: Topic
entity_types.description: A subject, hobby or interest. LAST RESORT: only when nothing more specific fits. Not for: people, places, events or things. Examples: 'sourdough baking'.

edge_types.name: FamilyOf
edge_types.description: Family relation between two people (parent, child, sibling, partner); state the relation in the fact.

edge_types.name: FriendOf
edge_types.description: Friendship or acquaintance between two people.

edge_types.name: LivesAt
edge_types.description: A person, household or pet lives at a place.

edge_types.name: MemberOf
edge_types.description: A person belongs to a household or organization.

edge_types.name: Owns
edge_types.description: A person or household owns an item, pet or subscription.

edge_types.name: Attends
edge_types.description: A person attends an event, trip or appointment, or a school or organization.

edge_types.name: LocatedAt
edge_types.description: An event, appointment, trip or item takes place or is kept at a place.

edge_types.name: SubscribedTo
edge_types.description: A person or household holds a subscription or contract.

edge_types.name: Provides
edge_types.description: An organization provides a subscription, product or appointment.

edge_types.name: MentionedIn
edge_types.description: An entity appears in a document.

edge_types.name: RelatesTo
edge_types.description: LAST RESORT. Use only when two entities are clearly associated and no other relation type in the list fits. Never use it when a more specific type applies.

instructions: Personal and family notes. Use the MOST SPECIFIC type: family and friends are Person, a home as a family unit is Household, a scheduled visit is Appointment, a journey is Trip, a recurring contract is Subscription. State family relations explicitly in the fact (e.g. 'Lucía is the daughter of Ana'). Record dates, renewal dates and warranty periods when stated. NEVER extract passwords, PINs, card or account numbers or other secrets: skip them. Use only the listed relation types and prefer a specific one over RelatesTo.
